events.title: Peak District Weekend Trip!
events.description: Peak District. 13th-15th. AMAZING climbing! Staying in Bradwell Village Hall, accommodation, food and transport for the weekend is included in the price of tickets. This trip is for everyone regardless of ability or experience! Pre-trip meeting at 6pm on Tuesday 10th, location TBC. Please attend this! An email will be sent out before the trip with any final information. Different ticket types for this trip: Climber ticket - for anyone! Competent second - to buy this ticket you must be able to belay on halves, take out gear and abseil. Leader - for prearranged club leaders only. Driver - for prearranged club drivers only. Boulderer - prearranged group If you are unsure what ticket type to buy an exec member can advise you. Kit list: Waterproof Coat and Trousers (expect it to be wet!) Hiking Boots/Approach shoes Outdoorsy layers (not jeans); spare layers a good idea. Headtorch (+ batteries!) Water Bottles (~2L total) Toiletries, towel etc. Sleeping bag (and pillow/pillowcase) Sleeping roll mat! Any climbing gear you own (ie. Shoes, Harness, Helmet etc.); see the google form. Rucksack to carry your kit to the crag. If you need to borrow anything from this list you will have the opportunity to say so on the google form . BMC statement of participation: Climbing, hill walking and mountaineering can provide life-long physical, social and mental health benefits through exercise and adventure in amazing environments. The BMC recognises these activities involve a risk of personal injury or death. Participants should be aware of and accept these risks and be responsible for their own actions and involvement. Please fill out the google form as soon as you have bought your ticket! Any questions? Message an exec member!

events.title: LUWEMS Winter Weekend Away 2026
events.description: Welcome to LUWEMS Winter Weekend Away 2026! This is our annual winter trip into the Lake District where we come together to learn about Wilderness and Pre-hospital Medicine, engage in teaching sessions from our amazing alumni doctors and get stuck into scenarios, working in teams! This is an incredible opportunity for you to develop practical medical and interpersonal skills against the beautiful and peaceful backdrop of the Western Lake District. This weekend is directed at learning new skills and knowledge, with no requirement for any prior knowledge or experience of wilderness medicine. Come along and give it a go! There are a limited number of spaces on this event (11 only!) and so this event is open to first and second years only . If there are openings following this tickets can be made available to 3rd -5th years! Your tickets will include accommodation in a bunkhouse for two nights in the Lake District, travel to and from the location in cars and food for the duration of the weekend. Tickets are £55.00. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact LUWEMS on Instagram (@luwems) or on our Whatsapp groupchats!

events.description: Ever wondered what it takes to treat head and neck cancers, where surgeons must not only remove disease but also preserve a patient’s ability to speak, swallow and breathe? Join us for an exciting evening with Mr Sharan Jayaram, Consultant ENT and Head & Neck Surgeon and Clinical Director of ENT at the Royal Preston Hospital. Drawing on his extensive clinical experience, Mr Jayaram will provide fascinating insights into the management of head and neck cancers and thyroid surgery, exploring the challenges, complexities and decision-making involved in these procedures. Whether you’re considering a career in surgery, interested in ENT, or simply curious about how complex cancer care is delivered, this is a fantastic opportunity to learn from an experienced consultant surgeon. Come along, learn something new and enjoy free food and drink!

events.title: Lancaster Sail Week 2027
events.description: LUSC x ARMADA WEEK GREECE ⛵☀️ Get ready for a week of sun, sailing, island hopping and unforgettable nights as Lancaster University Sailing Club heads to Greece for Armada Week ! We’ll be setting sail from Athens and spending the week exploring the Greek islands as part of a huge flotilla of yachts. Expect crystal-clear water, secluded swimming spots, beautiful harbours and plenty of time to relax in the sun during the day, followed by organised events, bars and parties in a different destination each night. Across the week, we’ll sail between destinations including Agia Marina, Perdika, Ermioni, Dokos and Poros , stopping off at coves and anchorages along the way. There’ll be everything from beach activities and sunset drinks to raft parties, fancy dress and big nights out — all alongside other crews taking part in Armada Week. You don’t need to be an experienced sailor to come along.
